items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Stock Looks Richly Priced After Its 47% Three Year Run
items.summary: Tesla has been busy reshaping its business around robotaxis, humanoid robots and energy projects while the share price has swung sharply, and that leaves a basic question for you as an investor. Is the current US$345.82 price tag adequately backed by what the company is generating through its sales today? Over the past 3 years the stock has gained 46.9%, which puts a lot of weight on whether recent top line performance can carry that kind of market value. A planned €3b expansion of the...

items.title: Tesla FSD V15 Rolling Out, Goes 'Wide' Next Month. Elon Musk Says It's 'Something Special.'
items.summary: Tesla Full Self Driving version 15 rolled out to initial FSD users on Saturday. A wide release is planned for next month, CEO Elon Musk said.

items.title: Musk Says Cybercab “Covers About 90%” of Passenger Miles. Tesla’s Next Robotaxi Is a Wheel-Less Model Y
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said at the DealBook Summit that Tesla plans an autonomous Model Y with no steering wheel or pedals, built for groups of six or seven riders. Building robotaxis from Tesla’s most popular car could get it to volume faster than the two-seat Cybercab alone.

items.title: Musk Won’t Take Stock Awards “Simply for Merging With SpaceX.” Tesla Shareholders Still Have to Vote
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said at the DealBook Summit that he shouldn’t receive Tesla stock awards just for merging Tesla with SpaceX. That eases a real dilution worry, since his 2025 pay package covers 423.

items.title: Trump Calls Huang’s Exit “Such a Tragedy” as His Filing Shows Up to $380,000 of Nvidia Buys
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTrump’s September trading report shows up to $380,000 of Nvidia buys, plus Tesla and SpaceX, and sales of $1 million to $5 million each of Home Depot and McDonald’s. The White House says outside firms run the portfolio, and most of the month’s money went into a dividend ETF and municipal bonds.

items.title: H-E-B, Southwest, Dell lead Forbes' best Texas companies list
items.summary: H-E-B beat out Southwest, Dell and ExxonMobil to top Forbes’ new list of the best companies based in Texas. Tesla squeaked in at No. 25.

items.title: Elon Musk Calls Anthropic’s Models ‘Great Products,’ Jassy Says ‘We’re Big Believers’: Mag 7 Voices This Week
items.summary: Elon Musk called Anthropic’s Opus and Fable models “great products” and described the company’s leadership as “principled” and “diligent.”
